SearchHow we decideRulings

Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Body, health & movement

vagina noun

also vulva, genitals, private parts

classical

Varr. RR 2.4.10: nātūram quā fēminae sunt
Cic. Div. 2.145: obsignātam habēre nātūram
M-O s.v. genitals

nātūra, nātūrae f.

noun, first declension

the private parts (here a girl’s or woman’s)

The decent word of Cicero and Varro, for either sex. It names the whole, which is what a parent usually means by “vagina”.

Examples

  • nostrae mulierēs, maximē nūtrīcēs, nātūram quā fēminae sunt in virginibus appellant porcum

    our women, and nurses above all, call the part that makes little girls female porcusVarr. RR 2.4.10

Other words

  • muliebria, muliebrium n. pl. — a woman’s or girl’s private parts

    noun, third declension, plural · also used · classical · Tac. Ann. 14.60; Traupman 58

    Tacitus’s word; the counterpart of virīlia.

  • porcus, porcī m. — a little girl’s private parts, in nurses’ talk

    noun, second declension · also used · classical · Varr. RR 2.4.10

    (vōx nūtrīcum: Varr. RR 2.4.10)

    Varro reports that women, nurses above all, call a little girl’s parts “piglet”, as Greek women say choeros. Otherwise porcus is simply a pig.

  • vāgīna, vāgīnae f. — vagina (the anatomical term)

    noun, first declension · also used · modern · Traupman 59; Plaut. Ps. 4.7.85 (Lewis & Short)

    Classically a scabbard, and so the anatomists’ word; its one bodily use in Plautus is an obscene joke.

  • cunnus, cunnī m. — the obscene word

    noun, second declension · avoid · classical · Cic. Or. 154; Cic. Fam. 9.22.2

    (vōx obscēna: Hor., Mart.)

    Lewis & Short: “as an obscene word, avoided acc. to Cic.”. Latin says nōbīscum, not cum nōbīs, Cicero explains, because the sounds would run together obscaenius (Or. 154).

  • volva (vulva), volvae f. — the womb

    noun, first declension · avoid · classical · Cels. 4.1 (Lewis & Short)

    Not the English vulva: in Latin the womb, and a sow’s womb as a delicacy (Hor. Ep. 1.15.41, Mart. 13.56.2).

See also penis.
